reviewFlags.issue: The catalog model MK-MG1300 appears on no fetched page. Only suffix variants were found (MK-MG1300WTN on shopelectrons.co.il, plus MKMG1300WTN and MKMG1300WTQ elsewhere). No facts were published for the exact model.

The sibling variant page gives 39.1 × 16.4 × 30.6 cm and 3.4 kg, which conflicts with the catalog's height, width and depth values and its 3.0 kg weight. The page is not evidence for this model, so the catalog values remain unverified.
Israeli variant is unclear. Panasonic official pages returned 404, and no source confirmed the Israeli plug type or Israeli importer for this exact model.
Only sibling pages were found. One mentions one year of warranty and another mentions 24 months. No source confirms the warranty for this exact model.
Power, voltage, grinding rate, dimensions, weight and materials in the catalog could not be verified on any page naming the exact model.
A sibling suffix variant page lists 39.1 × 16.4 × 30.6 cm and 3.4 kg, which differs from the catalog's dimensions and 3.0 kg weight.
Israeli variant/suffix unclear; only suffix variants MK-MG1300WTN/WTQ found on other pages.

qa.notes: Only one verifiable fact (gear/gearbox material) from the Panasonic MEA FAQ, which names the exact model. All catalog specs remain unverified; content kept minimal.
